result.title: RIFT: Reward Improvement Field Transfer for Cross-Domain Offline RL
result.comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables (10 pages main text; remainder references and appendices)
result.summary: Learning from limited target data is a central challenge in cross-domain offline reinforcement learning. Abundant source data can help, but dynamics differences can make direct transition reuse unreliable. We propose Reward Improvement Field Transfer (RIFT), which instead learns how low- and high-reward source transitions differ. RIFT encodes source and target transitions in a shared latent space, pairs low- and high-reward source transitions using optimal transport, and fits an affine field to their displacements. It applies this field to low-reward target anchors and decodes the results to augment the target dataset. The approach builds on the hypothesis that related domains can share useful low-to-high reward structure despite different dynamics. We bound synthesis error under shared class geometry, identify conditions favoring target anchoring over source-high transplant, and derive a conditional connection to downstream return. Experiments on dense-reward locomotion tasks under gravity, morphology, and friction shifts show improved aggregate performance over existing baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RIFT：在共享 latent 空间中用最优传输配对源域低奖励与高奖励 transition，拟合二者位移的仿射「奖励提升场」，再把该场施加到目标域低奖励锚点上并解码，以增广目标数据，并给出合成误差与下游回报条件的理论分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 「在共享 latent 空间中学习低奖励→高奖励的位移场并迁移施加」这一机制，可供核查能否用来定义或迁移 LVR 中潜在的推理状态更新方向，以及用「改善方向」作为隐状态的监督与贡献分配信号；但该文属离线 RL 数据增广，与视觉输入无关。
